title: Best Museums in Berlin for First-Time Visitors - Quick Summary
items: **Pick three museum slots across your trip, not thirty pins for one afternoon.** One long visit, one personal-interest museum and one flexible choice is a realistic first-time plan.
**Choose Neues Museum for a protected ancient-history half-day.** It is currently Tuesday to Sunday, with Monday closed; use the official page for the date and timed entry.
**Choose Jewish Museum Berlin when German-Jewish history is the question you want to follow.** The core exhibition is free, but the visit deserves time and attention.
**Use Topography of Terror as the flexible original-site history slot.** It is currently free and open daily, but it is a documentation centre, not a quick checklist museum.
**Do not buy a pass before you know your actual paid visits.** Check current ticket, closure and entry rules on the official sites before committing.
